acceptance: bundle-data-generation-hash-missing-from-corpus, datagen-p2-vectorize-synthetic-generators, and datagen-p2-rust-repo-gate are done, and every migrated Tier 3 benchmark exports a distinct post-cutover data_generation_hash.

Each validated Tier 3 synthetic benchmark has its default flipped in benchbox/utils/datagen_backend.py with Gate A, Gate C (owner-approved acceptance report + frozen golden hashes), and Gate D passing on all supported platforms.
--datagen-backend legacy remains functional and tested for every migrated benchmark, and a changelog.d/ fragment documents the cutover.
For any benchmark backed by the optional Rust package (if created in datagen-p2-rust-repo-gate), missing-extra behavior matches docs/internal/adr/adr-benchbox-datagen.md.
context: Phase 3 Tier 3 synthetic cutover. Independent of SSB's external pvm-p2/crr-c2 dependencies so validated Tier 3 benchmarks can cut over without waiting on SSB publication.
description:
## Problem
Once Phase 2 validates each over-budget Tier 3 synthetic benchmark (via vectorized Python or, if budget-missed and approved, BenchBox-dev/benchbox-datagen) and bundle-data-generation-hash-missing-from-corpus ensures published results carry data_generation_hash, each validated benchmark can cut over independently.

## Change
- Verify bundle-data-generation-hash-missing-from-corpus, datagen-p2-vectorize-synthetic-generators, and datagen-p2-rust-repo-gate are done.
- For each validated Tier 3 synthetic benchmark (h2odb, tsbs_devops, vector_search, coffeeshop, amplab, clickbench synthetic, joinorder_synthetic, tpch_skew — limited to those actually migrated in Phase 2), flip its entry in benchbox/utils/datagen_backend.py's default table once Gate A, Gate C, and Gate D pass on every supported platform.
- Retain --datagen-backend legacy for at least one minor release and add a changelog.d/ fragment ([CHANGELOG-001]).

## Decision gates
- Hard blocked on bundle-data-generation-hash-missing-from-corpus closing and Gate C owner acceptance per benchmark.
- Stop and report if pre-cutover and post-cutover datasets collide in shared datagen/ folders or produce identical data_generation_hash values.

## Guardrails
- Never invalidate unrelated benchmarks via global DATA_GENERATION_VERSION; use per-benchmark versions only.
- Never make any optional native Rust generator a required dependency of core benchbox.
- Never remove --datagen-backend legacy in this item.
- Follow AGENTS.md ([CHANGELOG-001], [RUN-DATA-001], [COMMENT-POLICY-001], linked worktree, make pr-preflight, merged PR).
